bindings.name: restart
bindings.surface_note: restart=true continues on an earlier run's products at imagename on the same grid, as CASA's SIImageStore opens them: the model (every Taylor term, cube channel and Stokes plane) is the start model, a CLEAN mask is reused plane by plane when no new mask is given, and with calcpsf=false or calcres=false the PSF, sums of weights and residual are read rather than formed. restart=false selects the next single-main-image namespace using CASA filename numbering.
